Auth.//: Validates the machine tokens the admin API requires. Authority is deliberately unset: the Auth Service publishes a JWKS document but no OpenID discovery document, so the issuer is pinned here instead of being learned from metadata. Port 5091 is the Auth Service's local profile; TASK-047 replaces it with the compose service address.

RabbitMq.//: TASK-043: dedicated vhost, publish-only least-privilege user (readings.exchange only, no queue rights at all).
